objective: T-20260928-18: preregister PUTW_HOLD (buy-and-hold PUTW, monthly), an honest proxy for dir:put_credit_spread_income's weekly SPY cash-secured put-writing claim, against the owner's 2026-09-28 relaxed keep rule (K1: median-offset Sharpe >=80% of S3's in both anchor and stress windows with positive 20bp CAGR; K2: an S3+candidate 63-day inverse-vol blend beating a vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control by >=0.05 Sharpe in both windows). scripts/screen_batch.py --batch h20260928_18_vix_putw --iteration h20260928_18_vix_putw_batch IS run against this manifest (unlike a normal preregistration-only round): PUTW is not served by Alpaca (see data-feasibility.json), so PUTW_HOLD is expected to come back skipped=True via screen_lane's own missing_symbols() check, not via a special case coded for this task. VIX_REGIME_SPY_SSO_TLT is intentionally NOT a candidate in this manifest (dropped by the owner's 2026-09-28 cross-asset scope decision; tracked in the registry as dir:spy_sso_tlt_vix_regime_rotation, status parked).

parameters.proxy_for: dir:put_credit_spread_income (weekly SPY cash-secured/credit-spread put selling, ~20-30 delta, 3-5 weeks to expiry, ERN structure -- unsupported by Alpaca at any options level)
proxy_caveats: PUTW writes MONTHLY at-the-money SPX (index-level) puts on a fixed 3rd-Friday roll, not weekly ~20-30 delta SPY puts -- different cadence, moneyness and underlying (index vs ETF) from the original ERN-style claim.

PUTW is a fully collateralized long-only fund position (buy-and-hold the ETF), not a synthetic replication of selling puts directly -- it removes ALL of the registry direction's original execution-feasibility concerns (Alpaca does not support naked/cash-secured put selling) at the cost of being a coarser proxy for the same volatility-risk-premium mechanism.

Even if the data blocker were resolved, PUTW_HOLD would only be evidence about the coarse monthly-ATM proxy, not about the weekly higher-delta structure the original ERN track record actually describes.
parameters.source: WisdomTree CBOE S&P 500 PutWrite Strategy Fund (PUTW) launch press release, 2016-02-24; CBOE S&P 500 PutWrite Index (PUT) official fact sheet, as of 2026-08-31

candidates.expected_skip_reason: PUTW is not served by Alpaca (this project's only market-data and paper-broker vendor): TradingClient(paper=True).get_asset('PUTW') raised APIError 40410000 'asset not found for PUTW', and StockHistoricalDataClient.get_stock_bars(symbol='PUTW', feed='sip') returned 0 rows for the most recent 10 trading days (both checked 2026-09-28). Control check with the identical calls: XYLD, QYLD, JEPI, JEPQ, DIVO all resolved tradable=True with bars returned. PUTW therefore cannot appear as a column in the panel scripts/screen_lane.py's load_batch_panel loads from data/sip/daily/*/*.parquet, so screen_lane.evaluate_candidate() is expected to mark this candidate skipped=True via its own missing_symbols() check when scripts/screen_batch.py is actually run -- not a special case coded for this task, the harness's normal, already-tested handling.

data_v1_alpaca_sip_daily_putw_not_availa.hygiene: drop bars with zero volume and zero trade_count

data_v1_alpaca_sip_daily_putw_not_availa.unavailable_reason: Not served by Alpaca at all (trading asset list or SIP market data); see PUTW_HOLD's expected_skip_reason above and data-feasibility.json.

feature_v1_vix_putw_batch_fixed_weight_r.fixed_weight_rule: PUTW_HOLD returns an unconditional fixed weight (1.0 PUTW) once PUTW has any price history, matching HFEA_UPRO_TMF/XYLD_COVERED_CALL_PROXY's pattern in scripts/screen_batches/h20260928_05_batch2.py. Implemented in scripts/screen_batches/h20260928_18_vix_putw.py's w_putw_hold, tested on synthetic data in tests/test_screen_batch_vix_putw.py. PUTW never appears as a real panel column (see data-feasibility.json), so this function is never actually called with real prices during scripts/screen_batch.py's run -- screen_lane's missing_symbols() check short-circuits evaluate_candidate() before weights_frame() would call it.
feature_v1_vix_putw_batch_fixed_weight_r.no_lookahead: w_putw_hold reads only close.loc[:asof]; tests/test_screen_batch_vix_putw.py's test_putw_hold_no_lookahead_on_future_price_history asserts appending future rows never changes an already-decided asof's weights.

benchmark_v1_vix_putw_batch_vs_s3_k1_k2.keep_rule: K1: median-offset Sharpe >= 0.80 * S3's median-offset Sharpe in both anchor (S3=1.49) and stress (S3=0.81) windows, with positive 20bp CAGR. K2: S3+candidate 63-day trailing inverse-vol blend beats its vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control by >= 0.05 Sharpe in both windows -- the owner's 2026-09-28 relaxed rule, unchanged from batch 2. Not applied in this round: no result exists to judge.

g3_not_applicable_reason: PUTW_HOLD's only parameter (weight 1.0, freq M) is copied verbatim from PUTW's own published mechanism, not fit to any window's return; no in-sample parameter exists to placebo-shift. Moot regardless: no backtest is run in this iteration.
